title: Snap a Bill: From Photo to Capped Card
tagline: Turn a paper bill into a calm, capped way to pay.
audience: Prepaid users new to scanning who want a gentle, step-by-step guide to paying bills with confidence.
objectives: Spot how SAM frames the bill in your photo
Explain what Muse reads: amount, store, and due date
Confirm details yourself before any card is created
Create a capped card using the suggested limit and end date

analogy.title: Highlighting a Receipt on the Table
analogy.story: Imagine a paper receipt on your kitchen table. First, you slide a clear frame around it so it stands out, just like SAM finding the bill box. Then a helpful friend leans in and reads the three important details out loud, the amount, store, and due date, just like Muse. Finally you nod to confirm the reading is right before clipping a small limit tag on it for safe paying.

pitch30Seconds: Have you ever held a bill and wondered how to pay it calmly? Just snap a clear photo. SAM gently finds the bill on the screen, then Muse reads the amount, store, and due date for you. You check the details and fix anything that looks off. Then we suggest a safe spending cap and end date. Accept, and we create your named capped card. Simple, soft, and you stay in control.

coreIdeas.plainWords: SAM looks at your photo and draws a neat box around the bill so we know what to read.
Muse reads three fields from inside the box: the amount to pay, the store name, and the due date.
You review the readings and correct any mistakes before any card is made, so you stay in charge.
We suggest a spending cap just above the bill and an end date tied to the due date to keep payments calm and safe.

howItWorks: Take a clear photo of your paper bill in good light.
SAM gently locates the bill and frames it on screen.
Muse reads the amount, store name, and due date from the frame.
Review the three values and correct anything that is not right.
Accept our suggested cap and end date to create your named capped card for this bill.

recallQuiz.question: What does SAM do in the Snap a Bill flow?
choices: Finds and frames the bill box in your photo
Reads the amount, store, and due date
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: SAM's job is to locate the bill and frame it so reading is accurate.

recallQuiz.question: What three fields does Muse read from the bill?
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Muse focuses only on amount, store, and due date inside the framed bill.

recallQuiz.question: Why do you confirm the details before creating a card?
choices: To catch mistakes and stay in control
To let SAM charge you faster
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Human review catches errors and keeps you in charge before any card is made.

recallQuiz.question: What does the suggested cap and end date do?
choices: Set a safe spending limit and time window for the bill
Remove the due date from the bill
Send cash to the store directly
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: The cap limits spending to near the bill amount and ends near the due date for safety.

safetyNote: Use only your scans. This demo uses test-mode sample money with no real charge. If you have a blurry photo retry with better light and a steady hand.
